record_type: Architecture and configuration, not a fitted-model export
primary_task: Classification of probable depression defined by PHQ-9 >=10
counterfactual_contribution: Median of full-expert predictions under selected domain substitutions; appended to expert probabilities before final median.

triage: Class-conditional prediction sets followed by reliability referral
fitted_values_note: Computed by fitting; unavailable as serialized model artifacts in the upload.
